description: Jest's documented custom snapshot matcher (B23e, D128) on a value that differs: a first local run stores the snapshots, then the captured run under `--ci` (the test file sends other values once the .snap exists) fails `trimmed` with jest-snapshot 30.5.2's own failure text (its `matcherHint`, `Snapshot name`, and the diff it prints with `this.snapshotState.expand` and `snapshotFormat`), and `with properties` with its property-matcher text after `this.snapshotState.fail`; `beside toMatchSnapshot` still matches. The failures reach Jest's totals (`unmatched`). One file, one worker.
